sources.source_name: DIFI / NAIC SBS Licensee and Company Lookup
sources.regulator: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions / NAIC State Based Systems
sources.identity_field: NPN / NAIC / SBS number when returned
sources.count_notes: Licensee = producer/agent/business entity. Company = insurer/administrator/service company. NPN != NAIC. Producer != agency != company. Marketplace participation != Arizona producer authority. Do not scrape.

sources.regulator: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions / NAIC
sources.identity_field: NPN on individual rows; business-entity name / license number on entity rows; NAIC on company reports
sources.count_notes: Official DIFI path to purchase a list: Generate a Report, Search Type Licensee, Entity Type Individual or Entity. Price on statebasedsystems.com support: $0.03 per row, $30 minimum, CSV. Not purchased. SEARCH_ONLY != zero. Paid != acquired.
sources.blocker: Paid report generator. Do not purchase this ticket.

sources.regulator: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions
sources.identity_field: NPN / NAIC / SBS number / DIFI matter number when printed
sources.count_notes: HTML table of consent orders, withdrawals, penalties, mergers, acquisitions. Recent rows print National Producer No., NAIC NO., SBS No. Mix of person producers and companies. Name-only adverse attach is UNSAFE. Complaint != violation. Not a license roster. Table is paginated; total UNKNOWN.

sources.source_name: List of Qualified Unauthorized Surplus Line Insurers
sources.regulator: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions
sources.count_notes: White list of unauthorized insurers that may write surplus lines in Arizona. NAIC present. This is not an Arizona producer or agency roster and is not net-new Arizona insurance companies. Eligibility list != license roster.

sources.source_name: Arizona Domestic Surplus Lines Insurers (Form SL-113)
sources.regulator: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions
sources.count_notes: Small official NAIC list of Arizona-domiciled surplus lines insurers. Not a producer/agency roster. Do not convert into Arizona insurance-company growth.

sources.source_name: DIFI insurance annual report professional/company aggregates
sources.regulator: Arizona Department of Insurance and Financial Institutions
sources.count_notes: FY reports publish producer-by-line and authorized-insurer aggregates. Aggregates are not a live roster. Do not say N licensed Arizona insurance companies from an annual table. Captive program stats are also aggregates.
